subject: Biotechnology
title: The Precautionary Principle
description: A quick win: understand The Precautionary Principle.

hook.text: When in doubt, do not — the precautionary principle says lack of proof of harm is not proof of safety.

buildup.text: Europe applies precaution broadly — if a biotech product might cause harm, restrict it until proven safe.

discovery.text: The US favors risk assessment — evaluate the actual evidence of harm before restricting innovation.

twist.text: Strict precaution can block beneficial tech — Golden Rice was delayed 20 years while children went blind from vitamin A lack.

climax.text: Proportionate precaution balances caution with urgency — matching strictness of controls to the severity and likelihood of risk.

punchline.text: Caution without paralysis — the precautionary principle shapes how nations govern biotech.

quiz.question: How did the precautionary principle affect Golden Rice deployment?
options: It sped up approval because the rice addressed a humanitarian crisis
Regulatory caution delayed approval for 20 years while vitamin A deficiency continued to cause blindness
It had no effect because Golden Rice was never regulated
